composition.currentLayout: DashboardScreen watches dashboardHomeScreenStateProvider, switches over loading/error/empty/full states, and composes DashboardSliverHeader, DashboardEmptySliverBody, DashboardFullSliverBody, and notification action slots. DashboardHomeScreenState owns route provider waves, retry targets, header copy, club-post notification ids, and empty/full selection.
composition.targetLayout: DashboardScreen should remain a thin route composer. Remaining migration work is below the full body: event focus and club-post updates should receive provider-free display data and typed callbacks from section adapters.

sections.name: Dashboard header
sections.targetOwner: registered Dashboard Home header section with view data and action slots
sections.migration: Header greeting/day/city derivation now lives in DashboardHomeScreenState with dashboardNowProvider. Keep the section provider-free and compare header spacing/type against exported design references before visual edits.

sections.name: Dashboard notification action
sections.migration: NotificationsAction retains notification loading, analytics, and routing semantics while delegating icon chrome, typed count formatting, zero hiding, and the 40px app-bar target to CatchIconAction.counted.

sections.name: Dashboard empty body
sections.migration: Keep first-event education local until reuse appears; pass CTA intent in rather than reading Routes directly from the nested hero card.

sections.name: Dashboard full body adapter
sections.migration: Route-level empty/full selection now lives in DashboardHomeScreenState. Remaining work is to split full-body section data and callbacks so DashboardFullSliverBody no longer watches club lookup providers for club-post notifications.

sections.name: Event focus list
sections.currentOwner: DashboardFullSliverBody supplies typed EventFocusActions and maps self-check-in mutation state into EventFocusCheckInState; EventFocusList renders the provider-free visual section.
sections.targetOwner: provider-free Dashboard Event Focus section with typed route/controller intents
sections.migration: Calendar, directions, check-in, swipe, review, and detail navigation intents flow through typed EventFocusActions supplied by DashboardFullSliverBody. Home renders all open windows in expiry order with live countdowns, followed by the upcoming and review lifecycle cards.

sections.name: Club post updates
sections.currentOwner: DashboardFullSliverBody passes club-post notifications while OrganizerPostsHomeSection resolves club display data.
sections.targetOwner: provider-free club-post update section fed by DashboardHomeScreenState
sections.migration: Move club display lookup out of OrganizerPostsHomeSection so the visual section receives provider-free card data and typed open-post callbacks.
